approval_scope: Team-confirmed v2.5 workbook labels; not live-model acceptance or operational validation.
importer: scripts/import-workbook-v25.py (Python 3 standard library); scripts/import-v2.mjs (Node standard library)
normalization: Evidence cell literal backslash-n separators normalized to line breaks before parsing.
Final IF/AND/equality formulas independently evaluated and compared with XLSX caches.
Workbook buyer_messages_t0 without occurred_at are available at failed_event.as_of; no earlier timestamp is inferred.
Scripted response event time is synthetic as_of+2 minutes; runtime interaction uses its own simulation clock.
Empty buyer_history explicitly validated; unsupported nonempty history fails import.
